ns2:course.label: Senior Seminar in Art History
ns2:course.description: Required seminar for undergraduate majors that offers students practical experience in research techniques. Focuses on a specialized theme of the professor's choice, and will incorporate extensive reading in a specific field of Art History and the completion of a substantial research paper. Prerequisite: ARTH 395. This course may be repeated up to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours. 3 Undergraduate hours only.
